description: Salt (including table salt and denatured salt): pure sodium chloride whether or not in aqueous solution: sea water
Meat and edible offal: of turkeys, cuts and offal, frozen
Fish: livers, roes and milt of fish, dried, smoked, salted or in brine
Crustaceans: live, fresh or chilled, lobsters (Homarus spp.), whether in shell or not
Coal: (other than anthracite and bituminous), whether or not pulverised but not agglomerated
Oils and other products of the distillation of high temperature coal tar: n.e.c. in heading no. 2707
Propylene, other olefin polymers: n.e.c. in heading no. 3902, in primary forms
Cork: corks and stoppers, of natural cork
Yarn: of coarse animal hair or of horsehair (including gimped horsehair yarn), whether or not put up for retail sale
Blankets (other than electric blankets) and travelling rugs: of synthetic fibres
Cement, concrete or artificial stone: building blocks or bricks, whether or not reinforced
Diamonds: non-industrial, unworked or simply sawn, cleaved or bruted, but not mounted or set
Iron or steel (excluding cast iron or stainless steel): seamless, casing and tubing, of a kind used in drilling for oil or gas
Gallium, germanium, hafnium, indium, niobium (columbium), rhenium and vanadium: articles thereof, other than unwrought including waste and scrap and powders
Insulated electric conductors: ignition wiring sets and other wiring sets of a kind used in vehicles, aircraft or ships
